objective: Compare sequential SAO H-to-plateau then W-to-plateau against MA-SAO H/W alternation from identical released checkpoints.

data.source: official mixed 500-task ALFWorld test_set used as a locally repartitioned research cohort
data.disclosure: This is not the paper's untouched held-out benchmark; test is sealed only within this campaign.

engineer.layout_reason: A no-update smoke reached the real critic backward pass but 2-way FSDP OOMed on an 18k-token trajectory with only 82 MiB free; 3-way FSDP is the minimum safe full-parameter layout.
engineer.budget_reason: Use small staged rounds and extend only after accepted development gain; each Engineer example already evaluates one patch on a ten-task packet.

solver.budget_reason: One ALFWorld episode expands into many full-history action trajectories; the four-episode smoke produced 47 action trajectories, so math-domain-sized 16x32 batches would be wasteful before an improvement signal.

ma_sao.centralized_critic: pre-action role, partner checkpoint, harness identity, partner version, and development calibration; actor remains decentralized
ma_sao.round_data_rule: cycle frozen task identities with a non-overlapping per-role sample offset; optimizer rows are newly generated unless explicitly marked replay
ma_sao.solver_cross_role_replay_reason: Official Harness-R1 ALFWorld reward receipts do not expose exact Solver behavior tokens/log-probabilities; do not fabricate MAPPO replay.

stopping.accept_candidate_only_if: paired dev gain > 0 and one-sided bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
stopping.converged_definition: minimum rounds completed and no accepted >=1pp dev improvement for two consecutive role rounds

comparison.material_ma_sao_gain: at least +5 percentage points over sequential SAO on sealed test with paired bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
comparison.schedule_search_gate: only after material MA-SAO gain on development and completion of both frozen-budget arms
comparison.initial_alternation: H1-W1-H2, then one W round followed by one H refresh

evaluation.development: 300-399 for stopping and candidate acceptance only
evaluation.sealed_test: 400-499 exactly once after both arm states are frozen
report_both: reward-selected global harness on unseen tasks
